summary: Pokémon retail is the loudest pack story today: Delta Reign and the 30th Celebration boxes launch on 6 November, shelves are thin, and collectors are angry about prices at stores like Dick's that are far above MSRP. Several small pack-ripping sites (RipLab, PlayTCG, PackBattle) are pitching straight at that frustration, and PlayTCG leads with Apple Pay and Google Pay. Collector Crypt news stayed mostly about the $CARDS token and the Upbit listing, while Solflare Packs got steady, friendly posts from community ripper accounts ahead of Breakpoint London. Fake-slab checks and the Pokémon TCG joining the Toy Hall of Fame are good light topics.

sources_note: Data from the x connector's full-archive post search, news search and post lookups, covering roughly 09:10 UTC on 5 Nov to 09:10 UTC on 6 Nov 2026. Likes, reposts, replies and follower counts are public_metrics as returned at fetch time; impressions are quoted only where noted. Third-party revenue and credit claims are unverified. No Phygitals, Watch.fun or Rip.fun news found in the window; Courtyard appeared only inside the renoipgp slab-scan post.
